title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature adds logging for incoming requests and errors, providing valuable insights for debugging and monitoring. It will include logging of request method, path, and response status code, as well as error messages. This will improve the overall debugging experience and help identify issues in production
testCases: Test logging for successful GET request
Test logging for failed POST request with error handling
acceptance: Request logging should include method, path, and response status code, while error logging should include error message and stack trace
reason: Improves debugging and monitoring capabilities, aligning with the framework's focus on production readiness and stability
